rules.title: Cryptographic controls for data at rest
rules.description: Datastores holding sensitive information must use approved cryptographic controls. Thematic mapping only — not ISO 27001 certification (QR-20 P1 architecture slice).
rules.remediationGuidance: Document expectations in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.RequiredControls; align services[].Tags and datastores[] with reviewer narrative in metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Sensitive storage public network access disabled
rules.description: Storage and data services holding sensitive information must disable public network access. Thematic mapping only — not certification (QR-20).
rules.remediationGuidance: Disable public network access on storage and data services; document exceptions in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Datastore encryption and TLS posture
rules.description: SQL and datastore endpoints must enforce encryption and restrict weak TLS posture. Thematic mapping only — not certification (QR-20).
rules.remediationGuidance: Require TDE and modern TLS on datastores; align services[].Tags with encryption controls.

rules.title: Public load balancer exposure restricted
rules.description: LoadBalancer services exposing sensitive systems must be justified and network-restricted. Thematic mapping only — not certification (QR-20).
rules.remediationGuidance: Prefer internal load balancers; document public exposure in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: NSG least privilege for sensitive workloads
rules.description: Network security groups for sensitive systems must follow least-privilege ingress and egress. Thematic mapping only — not certification (QR-20).
rules.remediationGuidance: Tighten NSG rules to required CIDR ranges; record exceptions in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Administrative ingress restricted
rules.description: Management ports on sensitive workloads must not allow unrestricted internet ingress. Thematic mapping only — not certification (QR-20).
rules.remediationGuidance: Restrict SSH/RDP to trusted CIDR or just-in-time access.

rules.title: Privileged containers restricted
rules.description: Workloads processing sensitive information must not declare privileged containers without isolation compensations. Thematic mapping only — not certification (QR-20).
rules.remediationGuidance: Remove privileged: true unless an approved exception is documented.

rules.title: Cryptographic protection of information at rest
rules.description: Sensitive information at rest must use approved encryption. Thematic mapping only — not certification (QR-20).
rules.remediationGuidance: Enable encryption at rest on every data store in the architecture.

rules.title: Micro-segmentation for sensitive workloads
rules.description: Sensitive workloads must run on segmented networks with restricted east-west paths. Thematic mapping only — not certification (QR-20).
rules.remediationGuidance: Place data-bearing services on isolated subnets with NSG or NetworkPolicy controls.

rules.title: hostNetwork workloads restricted
rules.description: Workloads with sensitive data must not enable host network access without documented isolation. Thematic mapping only — not certification (QR-20).
rules.remediationGuidance: Disable hostNetwork unless an approved exception is documented.

rules.title: Container privilege escalation restricted
rules.description: Containers processing sensitive information must disallow privilege escalation. Thematic mapping only — not certification (QR-20).
rules.remediationGuidance: Set allowPrivilegeEscalation: false on containers handling sensitive data.

rules.title: App Service HTTPS only
rules.description: App services transmitting sensitive information must require HTTPS only. Thematic mapping only — not certification (QR-20).
rules.remediationGuidance: Enable HTTPS-only on application endpoints.

rules.title: Transmission security
rules.description: Electronic transmission of sensitive information must use TLS 1.2+ and HTTPS-only endpoints. Thematic mapping only — not certification (QR-20).
rules.remediationGuidance: Require TLS 1.2 or higher on every internet-facing endpoint.

rules.title: TLS minimum for application endpoints
rules.description: Application endpoints handling sensitive information must enforce a modern TLS minimum. Thematic mapping only — not certification (QR-20).
rules.remediationGuidance: Set minimum TLS 1.2 on App Service, API Management, and load balancer listeners.

rules.title: Encryption in transit
rules.description: All network paths carrying sensitive information must encrypt data in transit. Thematic mapping only — not certification (QR-20).
rules.remediationGuidance: Require HTTPS-only for app tiers and encrypted SQL connections.

rules.title: Network security perimeter documented
rules.description: Network security perimeter must be documented and enforced. Thematic mapping only — not certification (PP-01 Option B / QR-20).
rules.remediationGuidance: Document the trust boundary and private-endpoint posture for data-bearing services.
